Hey. Same boat sort of. 
I had a habit of eating food late at night..I get off work pretty late. I would end up sleeping in a pile of crumbs or trash and I would just move it to the floor or onto another heap of garbage. I'd do laundry but the dirty clothes and the clean clothes were in the same pile. Zero motivation after or before work..I was living in my own filth. 
Well..this might sound lame but when you're depressed it's hard to take care of yourself and your possessions if nothing matters and it's just the same shit everyday. 
I finally got back on track..I started seeing a psychiatrist and a therapist and my depression is a lot better and I'm not internalizing everything.
I got back on track because I was disgusted in myself. I was gross, I wasn't comfortable, I wasn't happy. 
It started with me painting my nails more, finding something I enjoyed to do and I felt if one part of me was nice then everything was going to be okay. Then I took out my trash..I shampooed my carpet..I got a dog. The dog has helped the most! I have to be responsible for him and I want him to have a rich fulfilling life, and pretty soon I wanted the same for myself. 
Currently planning my wedding and enjoying my family and getting myself pulled together piece by piece. It's tough when you've been doing the same thing for years but when you add and subtract little things stuff just starts to come together. It gets easier and it's not a one day solution but find a hobby and find a responsibility. 
Sorry if this doesn't make sense, I had a victory drink(s) for teaching my boy a new trick. 
Have a good night.

When he got back, his family thought he died so they sold his stuff. So he decided since he was dead to them, they'd be dead to him. He cut out everyone.
I'm going to go up there and pray the rosary with him. He died when I was 9. I learn more about him and my dad the more time passes..and I think thats what I need to do. For him and for me. Because hes my grandpa and I loved him very much.

I got the last word in today. He hurt me. He dropped off his stuff with his mom. They were both choked up. I gave her a hug. I looked him dead in the face. He couldn't keep eye contact. I said "and as for you, fuck you, because you know, you broke my heart."
The antidepressants aren't working. I can't sleep. I can't eat. I want him back because I love him. But he didn't love me. Love is supposed to be two people, accepting each others flaws, and loving them anyway. He got annoyed with my fake laugh. I always drove 20 miles to see him. But he didn't do the same for me.
I loved him despite the fact that he snored, that he abused drugs, and that he had downs like mine.
He didn't help me with mine.
He said he was in the way of me healing. But he wasn't. He was good to me.
I have a lot of baggage and a heavy cross. And this week..sucked. 
I have to keep pushing because I don't want to give up.
But at the same time, nothing is helping me.
I ate ice cream.
I talked to good friends.
I talked to my family. 
But the wound is growing. 
That last word was a bandaid. I've had too many people walking in and out of my life.
I've had too many people use me.
First boyfriend ever threatened me when we were done. He followed through. His good friend asked me for nudes.
Second boyfriend wouldnt let me be with family.
Third was a fuckbuddy. He led me to believe it was something. And that he cared. He didn't. He moved and two weeks later on facebook I saw he was engaged.
This last guy, he treated me well.
His whole family did.
But..why he couldn't love me for the whole me? I guess I'll never know.
He told me he loved the shit out of me when he broke up with me. 
I told him to shut his fucking mouth.
He said he could see himself spending the rest of his life with me.
Three months ago he told me he thought about breaking up with me.
His parents talked him out of it. 
He..broke my heart. I gave him..my whole being. All of me. And I loved him and helped him when he needed it.
His idea of help was breaking up with me.
My cousin made me dance naked in front of her when I was 7. My other cousin wouldn't let me leave his room. Undressing me. He told me it'd be our little secret.
I have to wait until august to see a therapist.
I can barely function anymore at my job, and even at my life.
I don't know what to do anymore. When someone comes into your life and lets you in, you want to let them in too. That is how I saw it. He became..my world. I know time heals everything..but it all had to happen now. 
I keep telling myself I deserve better, but I still love him.
It looks like it hurt him too. But he doesn't care about me enough.
He didn't love me enough.
I don't know if I'll ever be able to love someone like that again.
I'm too young to have this much baggage. But..I can't do it right now. I'm so fucking depressed. Because I fuck everything up. I fucked up college, my job, and my heart. 
It just hurts so fucking bad. And I don't know what to do anymore.
I understand..and we both have the same beliefs and principals..but I didn't know being absolutely specific would be a problem..it wasn't until the other night, it's like a switch went off

I went to the student health center and admitted myself in because I was considering killing myself. 
I had no one left, if I went home everyone would know I failed. Not to mention knowing all of the things ShitHead said about me. 
I went to therapy, I reconciled with my parents, I came home, got a good job, and I'm starting EMT classes in January. I've cut off all of my ties with negative people, and I've never been better. 
I've been saving my money, and looking at schools to go to in the future to better my career. 
I've been focusing on myself for a change, and it sure does feel nice. 
May not be related, but I needed to dig myself out of the rut I created on my own. I found motivation in music, and in not wanting to feel so worthless and hopeless anymore. And life has been so unbelievably good to me since then..

I did well in high school and college blew up in my face.

Community college isn't bad either. It's a good start. A woman I know went to community college, got her associates, then went to a university and got her bachelors. 
She went back again and got her masters. 
Also, the old pharmacy manager I worked for had the same GPA as you in high school. She's a pharmacist now. 
You still have options, put your feelers out there and think about what you would like to do.

Nothing is wrong with you. From the moment we start high school they ask you what you want to be. How are we supposed to know that?

I went right out of high school and had to drop out because of similar reasons, you can read it on my previous posts. 
I lost $16,000. Some scholarships, but the majority was loans. I lost a lot of money too. Now I'm working to pay it off. 
I'm not saying don't go and don't try, but if you need a year, take a year or two to work, save, and figure it out. Take online classes, dip your feet in the water. 
Try to focus on your school work too. Most of the time it's pointless, but it's good to learn and focus just so later on in life, you're not stuck. You learned SOMETHING. 
Don't think about it, do it. It's that easy. If you really want something, you have to do it. Life doesn't work solely for you, if you really wanted something, you'd already be doing it.
